integrity: The group-theoretic proof covers all ranks and both extraspecial types, with the standard isotropic-subspace enumerations reconstructed. Independent small-group generator-image enumeration and independent two-plane subspace enumeration are bundled as finite replay evidence, not as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes and the two extraspecial groups of order p^(2n+1) are considered.
The isotropic-subspace enumerations and the full endomorphism parameterizations are established prior work, not new results.
An equivalent retraction enumeration may occur under different terminology outside the searched literature.
title: Retracts and idempotents of odd extraspecial groups in every rank
